shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/medical/power/pipes/climate, stairs/ladders/elevators, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH + VEF PipeSystem soft compat (typed bridges, clean signatures); Reverse Commands soft compat (reflection-only, zero typerefs).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid mineable rock, thick-roofed, 12C.
- Animal policy (conservative): pets follow master, obedient pets get send gizmos, non-pen unrestricted pets cross for food; pen animals never.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only. Modern Suite parity contract for any styled UI.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x, no power link, rotatable edge-hugging), grand staircase 2x2 (0.6x, quality scales climb), elevator (0.35x, power bridge, Extend shaft gizmos, ground car holds both links, two-hop rides auto-continue).
- Climb = 90t x type x quality x settings slider. All minifiable (uninstall collapses the far side, no refund; reinstall spawns fresh). Bomb >= 40 punches constructed rooftops (rock roofs immune).
- All consumers resolve links via CounterpartTowards(map); stair jobs carry their exit in targetC.
- Mounted riders (Giddy-Up) blocked from stairs jobs with a dismount message; mounts carrying riders skipped by the pet follow pull.

## Sky surface model (reworked 2026-07-19 after playtest)
- Three owned terrains: AB_OpenAir (see-through, impassable), AB_RoofSurface (corrugated steel rooftop, walk/build), AB_RockRoofSurface (natural rock roof top, walk/build).
- Mapping rule everywhere (genstep, live events, reconciliation): no roof below = open air; constructed roof below = rooftop; natural roof below = rock roof. The natural thin-roof overhang strip at mountain edges is rock roof, sealing the former see-through slivers.
- Three sync layers: genstep snapshot; live ground RoofChanged events; self-healing (subscription retry every 250t from MapComponentTick until it lands + bounded ReconcileRooftops sweep at FinalizeInit and every 2000t per sky map).
- Ore generation: ABOreGen scatters lumps (weighted by vanilla mineableScatterCommonality, modded ores included) into the basement fill and sky mountain walls, 6/10k cells, replacing only natural non-resource rock.

## See-below renderer (queue-layered 2026-07-19 - the invisible-rooftop root cause)
- RimWorld map shaders do not depth-write; painting order within a queue is distance-based, so drawing the lower map's meshes with their ORIGINAL materials let the below view overpaint the sky map's own terrain (grid said Rooftop, screen showed the room below; things layers survived because they sort back-to-front). Now the static below pass draws through cloned materials at explicit low queues (terrain 1000, water/shadow/scatter 1005-1030, things 1200 + altitude step, damage/snow/gas/pollution 1350-1500), cached per (material, queue) - every sky material (2000+) draws after, and therefore over, the below view. Documented in user lore (textures).
- Whitelisted content layers incl. water depth; air-cells light mask (night cap 0.45) rides FogOfWar queue over the below view, geometry only over air cells; silhouettes suppressed; ceiling hints; far clip 70.
- Known cosmetic: the below DYNAMIC pass (live pawns) keeps original transparent-queue materials and can ghost faintly over rooftop cells; mask still dims it over air. Revisit only if playtest flags it.
- Weather decider suppressed on pocket levels; surface sync sole driver.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Logistics: outbound haul + inbound fetch WorkGiver + demand pull (construction, bill shortfalls with aggregated alternatives, patient/prisoner meals) + export pinning + deterministic carried-cargo delivery after transfer.
- Build designator stuff picker is column-aware (pattern-guarded transpiler over the ListerThings.ThingsOfDef gate; ResourceCounter augmentation feeds the def source).
- Needs: rest routes to owned bed anywhere in column (two-hop) or free bed on linked level; food redirect for colonists and eligible pets.
- Medical/prisoners: cross-level rescue WorkGiver + capture float order via CarriedIntent continuations.
- One-colony UI: tables append other levels (ghouls in Schedule only; Fluffy Animal Tab via its RecachePawns); colonist bar groups ordered sky/surface/basement; level view buttons in the global controls row (Declutter UI bypass); camera preserves position and zoom; beds alert aggregates the column.
- Power/pipes/climate bridge per link (elevator second link included).
- Cross-map ordered work: ABPendingOrders replayed by StairTransfer on arrival.

## Performance architecture (2026-07-19 optimization pass)
- ABGuard switches are plain bools; LevelComp.AnySkyLevels static gate for the hot temp getters; NearestUsableStairsCached per-tick memo (incl. negatives) for the haul scanner; shared stairs-job helpers + WithPawnAt; small caches (Ext, meals, tooltips, ABIcons). Recurring: weather 150t, pipes/climate 250t, power 10t hash, rooftop sweep 2000t. Zero recurring cost with no levels built.

## Compat
- DBH + VEF pipe bridges (live-verified); Reverse Commands cross-level float menu; Fluffy Animal Tab append; Declutter UI SuppressExternal bypass; Giddy-Up mounted block; incompatibleWith telardo.MultiFloors + ZLevels1.1; RimThreaded unsupported (documented); foreign pocket maps read as standalone level-0.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Floating rim/ledge rock on natural roof loss (rare); sky projectile dim over air (cosmetic); below-pawn ghosting over rooftop (cosmetic, see renderer); bill radius vs stairs delivery; couples counted as singles in beds alert; RC scope direct links only; restaurants do not span levels; stuff picker sees direct links only.
- Threat policy: pocket levels raid-free; opt-ins slated for T8.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T10 DONE. Optimization + compat pass DONE. Playtest fixes round 3 DONE (2026-07-19): queue-layered below renderer (root cause of invisible rooftop across all three rounds), corrugated + rock roof terrains, subscription retry + reconcile sweep, column stuff picker, ore generation. Pending relaunch verification.
- Next: T5 publishing prep (field manual, Steam description, dependency audit, publish-hold, final regression with and without companions).
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration.

## Status
Round-3 renderer fix applied and compiling. Awaiting relaunch verification, then T5 publishing prep.
